excerpts.content:
Is there an easy way to get the container specs for the latest release?
I currently go back through the releases to see if the container I'm interested in is new or modified. For a container like `Validator`, I need to go through all releases back to phase 0.
https://ethereum.github.io/consensus-specs/specs/electra/beacon-chain/
